events.name: Special
events.custom_event_name: [WILLIAM STEPS INSIDE THE ROOM AND EXPERIENCES A STRONG SENSE OF FAMILIARITY]

events.name: Special
events.custom_event_name: [THE CAMERA REVEALS A BEAUTIFUL BUT TRAGIC-LOOKING PAINTING IN THE MIDDLE OF THE ROOM. IT APPEARS INCOMPLETE, WITH A FAMILIAR PORCELAIN MASK LYING ON THE FLOORBOARD BESIDE IT]

segments.text: This is… I knew this, that night…

events.name: Special
events.custom_event_name: [MEMORIES SUDDENLY FLOOD WILLIAM'S MIND, REVEALING THE MOMENT THAT CHANGED HIS LIFE AND FORCED HIM TO KEEP RUNNING]

events.name: Special
events.custom_event_name: [WILLIAM GASPS SHARPLY, STUMBLING BACK A STEP FROM THE DUST-COVERED CANVAS AND THE BLANK PORCELAIN MASK RESTING BESIDE IT]

segments.text: For years, William believed his father had simply gone mad from grief and ruin. Now, staring at the yellow sign and the unfinished canvas, the chilling truth settles in: it was never madness, and whatever his father tried to summon never left this place.
It wasn't just grief... Father wasn't trying to end it all.
He was trying to finish something.

events.name: Special
events.custom_event_name: [WILLIAM SLOWLY LOOKS DOWN AT HIS SHAKING HANDS, THEN BACK AT THE HOLLOW EYES OF THE PORCELAIN MASK]

events.name: Special
events.custom_event_name: [PLAYER INTERACTION: WILLIAM EXAMINES THE BOOK LYING IN THE ROOM AND READS ITS CONTENTS, REVEALING LOGS ABOUT THE RITUAL AND HIS FATHER'S ACTIONS]

segments.text: And he left the last piece waiting for me.
I'm sorry father, but I will end this madness…

events.name: Special
events.custom_event_name: [WILLIAM STEELS HIS NERVES AND STEPS FORWARD TO DESTROY THE UNFINISHED CANVAS AND END THE CURSED RITUAL]

events.name: Special
events.custom_event_name: [WILLIAM GRABS THE EDGE OF THE WOODEN FRAME AND PULLS HARD, TRYING TO TEAR THE CANVAS APART OR SMASH IT AGAINST THE STONE FLOOR, BUT THE FABRIC DOES NOT RIP AND THE WOOD DOES NOT SPLINTER, AS IF PROTECTED BY AN INVISIBLE FORCE]

events.name: Special
events.custom_event_name: [A SUFFOCATING WAVE OF HEAT WASHES OVER WILLIAM'S BACK, ACCOMPANIED BY THE SHARP SMELL OF KEROSENE, ASH, AND BURNING FLESH]

events.name: PlaySoundEffect
events.path: [<LOW, DISTORTED RUMBLE AS A WAVE OF SUPERNATURAL HEAT BUILDS>]

events.name: Special
events.custom_event_name: [WILLIAM SPINS AROUND, TENSING HIS JAW. NATHANIEL STANDS A FEW PACES BEHIND HIM IN THE SHADOWS, HALF OF HIS FACE AND HAIR ENGULFED IN SILENT, PALE-YELLOW FLAMES. THE FIRE CASTS NO WARMTH, AND HIS EYES STARE CALMLY THROUGH IT WITH A FAMILIAR, PATIENT SMILE]

segments.text: Always rushing ahead without thinking, Will.
You can’t break what isn't fully anchored to this world.
That canvas is bound to another world. Until your mind crosses over and connects to it, nothing in this room can touch it.
You’re not him. You’re just another phantom this house keeps throwing at me.
To destroy it, you have to wear the mask and complete the rite first.
Though... once you stand before Him, why throw it all away?
Look at this empty, rotting place, Will. Look at everything you broke. Mother, Diana, Walter... even me.
You ran away like a coward and left us all in the dark.

events.name: Special
events.custom_event_name: [NATHANIEL TAKES A SLOW STEP CLOSER, GESTURING TOWARD THE BRUSH AND THE PORCELAIN MASK BESIDE THE CANVAS]

segments.text: You want to fix it, don’t you?
You want our family whole again, sitting around that dinner table just like before.
Perform the rite, little brother. Once you're connected, give in to The King, and He can grant you everything you lost.
